name: Webstation
tagline: A web native emulation focused LXQt desktop based on Ubuntu.
description: Webstation is a web native emulation focused LXQt desktop based on Ubuntu.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/webstation:0.15.1-romm@sha256:696dd0fea59f808b2ff160957118cb7247ab95823d2448f7fe46b3fe726d1a03
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
